QuestInfo.name: A Sign of the Dragon Master's Return
QuestInfo.0: If you're curious about #bDragon Master Evan#k, go see Cassandra in town.
QuestInfo.1: #bCassandra#k says that she has some information for you regarding Dragon Master Evan. Go see her now.
QuestInfo.2: You found out that the return of Dragon Master Evan is close at hand.

0.0: Have you heard about the #bDragon Master#k? No? Hehe, that's what I figured. If you're curious about #bDragon Master Evan#k, come talk to me.

yes.0: You do know where I am right? I can be found in any of the major towns in Maple World.

no.0: I called you so that I could give you info about the #bDragon Master#k and give you a gift as a bonus but you don't want it? You're going to regret it...
